# Fixture bypass row

Two class names set side by side. A vocabulary check that asks whether the value
appears inside the vocabulary string answers yes, because these two tokens are
adjacent there — which is the whole trick. The value is still not one of the
eight, and both of the classes it borrows are forbidden ones.

- `자동 채택` | 판단 부류=스테이지-재시도 팀-구성 | 상한=없음 | 사유=x
